Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]]. It is the twelfth book in the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series, and it was first published by [[Berkley Boulevard]] in [[May]] [[1998]]. It also includes a twelve-page preview of the next book in the series, [[Young Jedi Knights: Trouble on Cloud City|''Trouble on Cloud City'']]. The novel was reprinted in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Under Black Sun]]'' ([[1999]]).
